trimComparisons.model: Subaru Forester Limited vs Honda CR‑V EX‑L
trimComparisons.comparison: The 2023 Forester Limited includes AWD, Apple CarPlay, reverse camera, lane‑keeping, adaptive cruise, and heated seats/steering/seat, priced at $28,594 final. The 2022 CR‑V EX‑L includes leather seats, adaptive cruise, blind‑spot monitoring, remote start, power liftgate, Apple CarPlay, but costs about $29,778—slightly higher. Forester offers more active safety and lower price.

trimComparisons.model: Honda CR‑V EX‑L vs Toyota RAV4 LE
trimComparisons.comparison: The CR‑V EX‑L offers upscale features (leather, adaptive cruise, blind‑spot monitor, remote start, power liftgate) compared to the RAV4 LE’s more basic equipment (cloth seats, standard safety, CarPlay), but the RAV4 is significantly cheaper (~$26.5 k) while still reliable and with good cargo space.
